name: com.katout.flowtask.unity
description: Unity integration for FlowTask: PlayerLoop driver for the default World (a Tick at the start of Update, configurable flush points), UnityEvent -> Signal, AsyncOperation / Awaitable -> FlowTask bridges, GameObject lifetime binding, optional uGUI helpers and a Scope Tree editor window.

samples.description: A confirm dialog, an enemy AI, a tutorial, a purchase, pausing and parallel loading written with FlowTask, and a demo scene (Demo/Demo.unity) to try them. Uses uGUI.
